# Answer key: short-letter.txt

## Prayer requests (expected)
- Wisdom for next year's outreach calendar (Strategic)

## One-time needs (expected)
- Water heater replacement, $300, no deadline stated

## What this fixture tests
A minimal letter (under 100 words) with exactly one request and one need,
both stated plainly in a single short paragraph -- the simplest possible
case, with no background spread across sections to resolve.
